posts.text: Northern Arc Q1FY27- The cos. has 2 business segements- D2C leding and providing lending solution to other Financial Institutions. Lending AUM is up 26% and D2C customer is up more than 50% YoY at 64% of total AUM which is of higher margin. Gross txn volume is down 5% YoY in Credit solution business. The focus of the co. is moving from Credit solution to D2C lending which is a good sign given they keep asset quality in check. 94% of the MFI book is CGFMU covered. “AltiFi” - their retail platform crossed 1 lakh subscribers. posts.text: Northern arc business mix is changing. Now they are lending directly from their books more which obviously have higher NIM. Market always give higher valuation to those who lend on its own books rather than generating AUM and then selling to some other finance institutions where NIM are obviously less.
